price_note: Placeholder prices. Muse Spark is served through an internal Meta endpoint with no public price list, so every model carries the same nominal $1 per million input and output tokens. The cost column therefore compares token use, not dollars. HW9 Part C: cached input for Muse Spark 1.3 is billed at 0.5 (a 50 percent discount, the conservative end of provider pricing); Muse Spark is served by SGLang, which caches shared prefixes automatically and reports cached tokens. HW9 Part D: Muse Spark 1.1 and 1.2, the cascade proxy candidates, are given an assumed price of one quarter of 1.3 so the cascade has a price gap to work with; this price is invented, not observed.
